satirlar.metin: Many successful founders share these five habits, and you can start them today. Let us count down!
Number five: reading. Many founders learn from books and podcasts every day.
Number four: tracking your money. Know what comes in and goes out first.
Number three: saving first. Set some money aside the moment you get paid.
Number two: learning from failure. Setbacks are common, and smart founders treat them as lessons.
And number one… starting before you feel ready. Small steps beat perfect plans.
Which habit would you start first? Comment below and subscribe!
